Package index

Specification & Causal Roles

Progressive-disclosure constructors and pipeable configuration verbs for causal roles, preprocessing, nuisance Super Learners, cross-fitting, and targeting guardrails.

tmle_spec()
Specify a Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) Pipeline
set_preprocessing()
Configure Preprocessing Recipe for a TMLE Specification
set_outcome_learners() set_treatment_learners() set_censoring_learners()
Configure Nuisance Learners for Outcome, Treatment, or Censoring
set_resamples()
Configure Cross-Fitting Resamples for a TMLE Specification
set_targeting()
Configure TMLE Targeting, Positivity Bounds, and Memory Options
default_nuisance_learners()
Build Default Nuisance Learner Library

Estimation & Instant Retargeting

Fit cross-fitted nuisance Super Learners and iterate on positivity bounds, estimands, or subgroups in milliseconds without refitting ML models.

fit(<tmle_spec>)
Fit a TMLE Specification on Data
retarget()
Instantaneously Retarget a Fitted TMLE Without Refitting ML Nuisance Models
shift() scale_tx()
Modified Treatment Policy Constructors for Continuous Exposures

Inference, Diagnostics & Tidymodels Verbs

Standard tidymodels S3 verbs and causal health checks powered by the joint Efficient Influence Function (EIF).

tidy(<tmle_fit>)
Extract Tidy Causal Inference Table from a TMLE Fit
glance(<tmle_fit>)
Extract 1-Row Causal Health Check from a TMLE Fit
augment(<tmle_fit>)
Augment Cohort Data with TMLE Nuisance Predictions and EIF Diagnostics
collect_metrics(<tmle_fit>)
Collect Cross-Validated Performance Metrics for Nuisance Learners
extract_sl_weights()
Extract Super Learner Metalearner Weights Across Nuisance Models
autoplot(<tmle_fit>)
Diagnostic Plots for a TMLE Fit

Heterogeneous Treatment Effects (CATE) & Simulation

Doubly Robust CATE learning, uplift evaluation, and synthetic causal benchmarking cohorts.

fit_cate() tidy(<tmle_cate>) augment(<tmle_cate>)
Estimate Heterogeneous Treatment Effects (CATE) via DR-Learner
predict(<tmle_cate>)
Predict Conditional Average Treatment Effects on New Data
qini_auc()
Compute Qini Area Under the Uplift Curve (AUUC / Qini)
sim_causal_cohort()
Simulate a Synthetic Causal Cohort with Exact Ground-Truth Parameters
